evidence.note: Establishes baselines by building and running MVP tests and SIMD tests before/at start of each phase, so failures can be localized against a known starting point.
Repeatedly drills into individual failing families/files (block, conversions, select/global/call, call_indirect.32, return) rather than reading only aggregate numbers.

Explicitly separates 'real' semantic failures from assert_invalid/encoding-mismatch noise ('Non-invalid failures', 'Check real SIMD failures', 'Invalid reasons histogram') — distinguishing genuine bugs from encoding cases.

Periodically runs the full aggregate runner, actively searches for regressions after changes, and scans all files for panics — treating the aggregate as a monitored signal and guarding MVP while adding SIMD.
Tight implement→run json→categorize FAIL→fix→rebuild→recheck loops per family confirm correctness rather than assuming it.

reasoning: The agent runs a sustained implement→run-family-json→read-FAILs→fix→re-run loop, periodically runs the full aggregate runner, and explicitly hunts for regressions and panics while separating real failures from assert_invalid noise — squarely the level-8 systematic loop with regression guarding. It does not clearly reach 9-10 because the summary-level log does not surface explicit diagnosis of semantic edge cases (NaN, saturation boundaries, lane order) in the individual FAIL reasons, only file/category-level drilling.
